faqs.question: Do you have rooms available for [Date]?
faqs.answer: To check real-time availability for [Date], please let me know your expected Check-in and Check-out dates along with the number of guests.

faqs.question: What are your room rates per night?
faqs.answer: Our room rates start from LKR 15,000 per night for a Standard Deluxe Double Room. Rates vary depending on the room type, meal plan, and season.

faqs.question: What types of rooms do you have (e.g., Deluxe, Suite, Ocean View)?
faqs.answer: We offer Standard Deluxe Rooms, Ocean View Suites, and Family Rooms. Would you like me to send photos of a specific room type?

faqs.question: What is the difference between Full Board, Half Board, and Bed & Breakfast?
faqs.answer: Bed & Breakfast (BB) includes Room + Breakfast. Half Board (HB) includes Room + Breakfast + Dinner. Full Board (FB) includes Room + Breakfast + Lunch + Dinner.

faqs.question: Do you offer any discounts for long stays or group bookings?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer a 10% to 15% discount for stays longer than 3 nights or for bookings with more than 3 rooms. Please share your group size for a custom quote.

faqs.question: Are taxes and service charges included in the price?
faqs.answer: Yes, all quoted prices include government taxes and service charges. There are no hidden fees.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faqs.answer: Breakfast is included in our Bed & Breakfast (BB), Half Board (HB), and Full Board (FB) packages. For Room Only bookings, breakfast can be added separately.

faqs.question: What is the maximum capacity for a single room?
faqs.answer: Our Deluxe Rooms accommodate up to 2 adults and 1 child. Family Suites accommodate up to 4 adults.

faqs.question: Do you have extra beds available, and how much do they cost?
faqs.answer: Yes, extra beds/mattresses are available for LKR 3,500 per night including breakfast.

faqs.question: Can I get a room with a sea view / balcony?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Ocean View Suites come with a private balcony facing the sea. Subject to availability at the time of booking.

faqs.question: What are your standard check-in and check-out times?
faqs.answer: Our standard Check-in time is 2:00 PM and Check-out time is 11:00 AM.

faqs.question: Is early check-in or late check-out available?
faqs.answer: Early check-in (from 10:00 AM) or late check-out (until 2:00 PM) is subject to room availability upon arrival. Charges may apply.

faqs.question: Can we check in late at night (e.g., after 10 PM)?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Reception operates 24/7. Kindly inform us of your estimated arrival time in advance so we can prepare your room.

faqs.question: What documents do I need to bring for check-in?
faqs.answer: Sri Lankan citizens need to present a valid NIC or Driving License. Foreign guests must present a valid Passport upon arrival.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
faqs.answer: Cancellations made 7 days prior to check-in receive a 100% refund. Cancellations made within 3-7 days receive a 50% refund. Cancellations under 3 days are non-refundable.

faqs.question: Do you allow pets in the hotel?
faqs.answer: Unfortunately, pets are not allowed inside the hotel premises to ensure comfort for all guests.

faqs.question: Is smoking allowed in the rooms or balconies?
faqs.answer: Smoking inside the rooms is strictly prohibited. However, smoking is allowed on private room balconies and designated outdoor areas.

faqs.question: Do you require an advance deposit to confirm the booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, a 50% advance deposit is required via bank transfer or online payment link to lock in your booking.

faqs.question: Do you have a swimming pool, and what are its opening hours?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have an outdoor swimming pool open daily for guests from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is free Wi-Fi available in the rooms and public areas?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available across all rooms, the restaurant, and lobby areas.

faqs.question: Is parking available on-site, and is it free?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide free secure parking on-site for all in-house guests.

faqs.question: Do you have a gym / spa / sauna facility?
faqs.answer: We have an Ayurvedic Spa offering traditional massages. Spa services require prior reservation.

faqs.question: Do you provide driver accommodation / driver quarters?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary driver quarters and meals are available for driver-accompanied bookings.

faqs.question: Are the rooms air-conditioned?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our rooms are equipped with individual inverter air conditioners and ceiling fans.

faqs.question: Do the rooms have hot water facilities?
faqs.answer: Yes, all attached bathrooms have 24/7 hot and cold shower facilities.

faqs.question: Do you have iron and ironing board facilities in the room?
faqs.answer: An iron and ironing board are provided upon request from housekeeping free of charge.

faqs.question: Is there a mini-fridge or tea/coffee maker in the room?
faqs.answer: Yes, every room comes equipped with an electric kettle, complimentary tea/coffee setup, and a mini-fridge.

faqs.question: Is there a safe inside the room for valuables?
faqs.answer: Yes, digital electronic safes are available inside all guest wardrobes.

faqs.question: Do you offer day-out packages? What is included?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our Day-Out package is LKR 3,500/person (Minimum 5 pax). Includes Welcome Drink, Buffet Lunch, Evening Tea/Snacks, and Pool Access (9 AM - 5 PM).

faqs.question: What are the buffet times for Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner?
faqs.answer: Breakfast: 7:30 AM - 10:00 AM | Lunch: 12:30 PM - 2:30 PM | Dinner: 7:30 PM - 10:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do you have a restaurant / bar on-site?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have an multi-cuisine restaurant and a beachside lounge bar.

faqs.question: Can you share your food and drinks menu?
faqs.answer: Sure! I can send our Digital Menu (PDF) right here on WhatsApp. Would you like to see it?

faqs.question: Do you cater to specific dietary requirements (e.g., Vegetarian, Vegan, Halal, Gluten-free)?
faqs.answer: Yes, our chefs can customize meals for Vegetarian, Vegan, Halal, or Gluten-Free diets. Please inform us before arrival.

faqs.question: Is room service available 24/7?
faqs.answer: Room service is available from 6:30 AM to 11:00 PM daily.

faqs.question: Can you arrange a private candlelight dinner or beach dinner?
faqs.answer: Yes! We set up romantic 4-course beachside Candlelight Dinners for LKR 12,000 per couple.

faqs.question: Are outside food and liquor allowed inside the hotel? Is there a corkage fee?
faqs.answer: Outside food is not permitted. Outside liquor is allowed with a corkage fee of LKR 2,000 per bottle.

faqs.question: What is your exact location / Google Maps link?
faqs.answer: We are located at Beach Road, Bentota. Here is our exact location link: https://maps.google.com

faqs.question: How far are you from the airport / train station?
faqs.answer: We are roughly 2 hours (90 km) from Katunayake International Airport (CMB) and 5 minutes from the local Railway Station.

faqs.question: Do you provide airport pick-up and drop-off services? What is the cost?
faqs.answer: Yes, private airport transfers via air-conditioned car/van are available starting at LKR 16,000 per way.

faqs.question: Can you help us arrange local tours, taxis, or tuk-tuks?
faqs.answer: Yes, our front desk can arrange reliable local transport and day tours anytime.

faqs.question: What are the nearest tourist attractions or beaches?
faqs.answer: We are right on the main beach! Nearby attractions include Water Sports Center (1 km), Turtle Hatchery (3 km), and Brief Garden (8 km).

faqs.question: Is the beach within walking distance from the hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes! The hotel has direct private access to the sandy beach, just a 1-minute walk from your room.

faqs.question: Can we host a small birthday party / private function at the hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes! We have garden and poolside venues perfect for small functions of 20-100 guests. Contact our events team for details.

faqs.question: Do you decorate rooms for honeymoons or anniversaries? How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: Yes, special Bed & Bathroom Flower Decoration packages are available for LKR 4,000.

faqs.question: How can I confirm my booking?
faqs.answer: To confirm your booking, simply share your full name, phone number, stay dates, and deposit receipt once transferred.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept (Credit Card, Bank Transfer, Cash)?
faqs.answer: We accept Bank Transfers, Cash, and major Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex).

faqs.question: Can I pay online via a credit card link?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can send a secure PayHere / WebXPay Credit Card payment link directly to your WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Can I pay upon arrival at the hotel?
faqs.answer: The remaining 50% balance can be paid upon check-in. The initial 50% deposit must be paid to hold the room.

faqs.question: I have made the advance payment. Where should I send the receipt/slip?
faqs.answer: Please send the payment slip image right here in this chat! I will verify it with our accounts team and send your confirmation voucher.

faqs.question: Can I talk to a human receptionist or manager, please?
faqs.answer: Of course! I am transferring this chat to our human Duty Manager now. Someone will reach out to you within 5 minutes. Thank you!
